title: Tech Note: Using Lasso 4D to Connect 4D and WebSTAR

historical_commentary.text: Both Lasso (as a WebSTAR plug-in) and WebSTAR itself are long discontinued products, and 4D's own built-in web server has for many years superseded the need for such third-party web server integration, making this note's specific integration path obsolete and of historical interest only.
related_updates: Both WebSTAR and the Lasso 4D plug-in are long discontinued; 4D's own built-in web server has superseded the need for this kind of integration
